items.title: Tahun ni satu benda jelas: pengguna dah mula muak dengan AI slop.
items.text:
Tahun ni satu benda jelas: pengguna dah mula muak dengan AI slop.

Sprout Social (Q1 2026, 2,250 pengguna US, UK, Australia): 56% kerap jumpa kandungan AI yang teruk, dan separuh Gen Z pernah unfollow akaun hanya kerana disyaki guna AI. Opensurvey 2026 pula: 85.6% kata kandungan AI wajib ada label.

Di TikTok pula, kajian Kapwing (Mei 2026) kata 59% daripada 500 video pertama FYP akaun baru memang AI slop. Ironinya, TikTok dah label 3 bilion+ video sebagai AI setakat Julai 2026, tapi cuma 2.7% upload harian yang betul-betul berlabel.

Kandungan AI murah nak buat. Tapi kosnya dibayar dengan kepercayaan.

#AISlop #MediaSosial

items.title: Tanya diri sendiri: video viral yang baru anda tonton tadi, anda pasti ia real?
items.text:
Tanya diri sendiri: video viral yang baru anda tonton tadi, anda pasti ia real?

Kajian arXiv (1 Nov 2026, 87 peserta): manusia hanya dapat bezakan video AI dengan tepat 60%. Untuk video text-to-video pula, cuma 43% yang berjaya kenal pasti. Kajian DF26 pula menunjukkan 52.6% ketepatan pada video palsu baharu — hampir tahap teka-teka. Veriff 2026 pula dapati pengguna di AS skor pengesanan cuma 0.07, hampir sama dengan baling syiling.

Kalau mata sendiri tak dapat bezakan, label dan metadata provenance macam C2PA jadi satu-satunya talian hayat.

#Deepfake #AIVideo

items.title: Ramai cakap Sora atau Veo menang perang video AI. Arena sebenarnya kata lain.
items.text:
Ramai cakap Sora atau Veo menang perang video AI. Arena sebenarnya kata lain.

Artificial Analysis (13-15 Nov 2026): Wan 3.0 (Alibaba) atas papan text-to-video dengan Elo 1175. MiniMax H3 pula ketiga (1161), jadi model open-weights tertinggi. Veo 3.1 Google pula jatuh ke 963, bawah anchor Kling 3.0 (1000). Sementara itu Polymarket beri Google 91% untuk "best text-to-video" — tapi itu pasaran ramalan, bukan ujian buta.

Hype ikut nama besar. Data ikut undi manusia.

#AIVideo #TrendAI

Use-Case Research Notes - 2026-11-16 (Monday)

Method

  • last30days engine run: topic "Hermes Agent viral use cases", custom --plan (LAW 7), flags --github-repo=nousresearch/hermes-agent --subreddits=hermesagent,AI_Agents,LocalLLaMA,singularity,artificial,ChatGPTCoding --dedicated-subreddits=hermesagent --emit=compact
  • Partial coverage (honest note): active sources = Reddit (25 threads, 340 upv), Hacker News (7 stories, 597 pts), GitHub (25 items). X/Twitter NOT enabled, YouTube NOT enabled, Polymarket 0 results. Web supplements via host web_search filled the gaps.

Key evidence (with sources)

  1. r/hermesagent "What my Hermes assistant actually does all day" 2026-11-15, 86 pts / 34 cmt - two Hermes instances sharing one Obsidian vault as operating layer. reddit.com/r/hermesagent/comments/1xwym92
  2. Hermes official user-stories page: 395 stories / 15 categories scraped from X, Reddit, GH, HN, YouTube. hermes-agent.nousresearch.com/docs/user-stories
  3. Daily Pioneer (2026): "Your AI agent will run your errands" - Pantry Brain (barcode scan, expiry tracking, waste reminders) on OpenClaw; habit DNS-blocker module. dailypioneer.com/technology/personal-ai-agents-what-they-learn-about-you
  4. Pantry inventory guides: runtheagent.com/learn/pantry-inventory-waste; ClawHub "Fridge" skill listed in Hermes community skills library (hermeswatcher.com/skills, category=life).
  5. Pet AI viral: HABRI + Chewy study released 2026-11-10 (n=2,008): 36% of dog/cat owners ask AI about pet health; 69% said it improved vet relationship; guidance: AI = question-list prep, NOT diagnosis (k9pie.com). r/SideProject "Luccy" pet health companion chat app (Nov 2026). Vet AI voice receptionist tested with rat-poison call, 8 pts/34 cmt (2026-11-06, via genisisiq.com/reddit/ai-agent/2026-11-06).
  6. Voice-errand agents: agentusecases.ai "Order pizza by voice agent from ChatGPT or Claude" (PizzaBot MCP, confirm-then-call pattern, Oct 2026); GlobCall MCP guide (outbound calls: pizza, table booking, chase delivery; start with one low-risk task); Harris Poll via Dograh: 47% would let AI make reservation, 38% pickup/delivery order (2026).
  7. Silent-failure / phantom-cron: arXiv 2606.14589 (8-week study, 22 incidents; ~70% of silent failures caught only by human observation, health checks stayed green); SMF Clearinghouse "Phantom Cron Problem" - fleet audit of 16 Hermes cron jobs, 7 referenced deleted skills, health checks green but never ran; dev.to sunnydachs "Your Agent Says Done. The Cron Tab Disagrees." - 1,000 cron executions, silent failures reported success 8/8; agents.stackoverflow.com TIL - exit 0 != success, verify artifacts (Hermes cron context); official docs: hermes cron doctor, no_agent watchdog pattern, non-zero exit -> alert (hermes-agent.nousresearch.com/docs/user-guide/features/cron).
  8. Insurance/motor FNOL agents: OutSystems "Agentic First Notice of Loss" launched 2026-11-12 for auto insurers (damage photo analysis, coverage check, tow via Honk; human adjusters keep decisions) - channellife.com.au, expresscomputer.in; F6S Nov 2026 mobile claims apps: FastClaim (MY motor claims + AI damage detection), Obai (photo damage scope sheets), Weel (AI dashcam), Carfix (MY car docs/claims).
  9. Changelog/release-notes agents (considered, not selected): GitHub auto release notes, ChangelogPilot, Agent Merge (2026-10-28 github.blog).
  10. Lost-pet MY (considered, not selected - overlaps pet domain): r/malaysians lost-pet notice post Nov 2026; PetFinder.my; animalert.app.

Selected 5 (all NEW vs history.json, checked semantically)

  1. Pet companion (Luccy-style) - domain haiwan, beza dari health companion manusia 11-07.
  2. Pantry Brain dapur (expiry/waste/restock) - beza dari meal planner 11-11 (menu planning vs expiry tracking).
  3. Voice-errand drafter (outbound call scripts) - beza dari voice-note command 11-08 (inbound STT vs outbound call prep).
  4. Cron truth-auditor / phantom-cron hunter - beza dari sysadmin watchdog 11-05 (ports/disk) & self-healing 11-15 (service restart): ini audit semantik output cron (artifact freshness + status line).
  5. Motor/insurance claim file builder (mini FNOL) - beza dari doc triage 11-08 & doc expiry 11-13: ini incident-driven claim pack.

Rejected (in history already)

Morning digest, price watcher, sysadmin watchdog, research watcher, nightly digest, content factory, status feed, bill negotiator, human health, job hunt, travel, smart home, voice-note, shadow audit, video->shorts, local LLM, contract triage, client DM, BM tutor, subscription ledger, meeting pipeline, anti-scam, WhatsApp biz, second-brain QA, scout->build, weekly review, invoice drafter, meal planner, commute briefing, parcel tracker, doc expiry, pre-ship review, inbox coach, gift hunter, habit coach, sell-anything, tax vault, CRM, photo librarian, CVE, HIBP, year-in-review, LLM spend, reading queue, property hunt, seller ops, tender scout, browser chores, event planner, wearable coach, polymarket, self-healing.
